name: V25
description: Two-stage bone tumor screener: EfficientNet-B3 gate (300px) + EfficientNet-B6 specialist (456px), fine-tuned on the entity families the error anatomy flagged (ABC, bone island, chondroblastoma, CMF, BFH, chondrosarcoma, adamantinoma, chordoma, angiosarcoma, GCT, fibrous dysplasia, metastases) plus 38 harvested radiographs of the same diagnoses.

wild.note: FINAL deduplicated board: 172 unique real-world radiographs (81 cancers) from Radiology Assistant + bonetumor.org. Two contamination sources were measured and removed: (1) 19 films that were byte-identical to harvested training images, 8 of them inside the 78-film held-out slice, because the harvest and the pool were crawled from the same cases under different names; (2) 9 near-duplicate PAIRS inside the pool itself (pHash Hamming 0 re-encodes of the same film, e.g. webchondrosarcoma_2 vs webchondrosarcoma_3) that md5 could not see. On the raw 199-film board the same model scored 143/199; on the 180-film leak-free board 131/180; on this final board 126/172.

independent.note: 50 radiographs from Wikimedia Commons, a THIRD source unseen by any model; V21 scored 11/50. 46 benign / 4 malignant, so it tests generalisation, not cancer recall. This pool also contains 9 near-duplicate pairs, which are counted here as-is.

selection_rule: malignant recall >= 80% of the 81 wild cancers, then max combined correct across the 564 benchmark + 172-film final wild board + 50 third-source films

known_caveats.benchmark_internal_duplicates: the 564-film benchmark contains 22 near-duplicate pairs (the same BTXRD image filed as both btxrd_IMGxxxxx.jpeg and tb2_IMGxxxxx_jpeg.rf.<hash>.jpg). The kernel's train/val/test dedup is md5-based, so re-encodes slip through it. Not corrected, because changing the benchmark would invalidate every comparison in this project.
known_caveats.wild_pool_has_no_normal_films: it is a tumour-only population, so it cannot measure the normal class at all
known_caveats.bands_are_in_distribution: the reliability bands are calibrated on the benchmark and are optimistic on unfamiliar sources; no confidence signal tested transfers across sources (0.571-0.627 AUC)
